_comment: Hand-maintained. Layer and disposition per module. scripts/module_registry.py reads this and writes registry.yaml. Dispositions are PROPOSALS until the owner approves them in docs/erp/project/DECISION_REGISTER.md.
rule: A module may depend only on modules in its own layer or a lower one. 'internal' and 'venture' may depend on anything; nothing outside them may depend on them.

mumtaz_base.note: Second foundation (46 lines). Candidate to fold into mumtaz_core.

mumtaz_branding.note: One of three brand sources (with mumtaz_theme and brand/tokens.css).

mumtaz_api.note: Overlaps mumtaz_api_gateway by name; ships no access CSV.

mumtaz_subdomain_routing.note: Contains the only raw SQL in the tree.

mumtaz_portal_routing.note: Depends on mumtaz_cfo_base (a product): routing should not depend on a product.

mumtaz_website.note: Earlier marketing-site prototype with its own controllers and navbar; superseded by mumtaz_website_builder (21 Nov 2026). Keep until the production homepage is cut over, then retire.

mumtaz_website_builder.note: Mumtaz Digital homepage as native Website Builder blocks + CRM demo form; CSS scoped to .o_mumtaz_site.

mumtaz_ai.note: One of four AI/CFO module families; no tests, no documented policy.

mumtaz_zaki.note: Does not depend on mumtaz_ai or mumtaz_core.

mumtaz_cfo_toolkit.note: Installer shell for the CFO family.

mumtaz_einvoicing.note: UAE QR, KSA ZATCA, Pakistan FBR. Statutory output with no tests.

mumtaz_financial_reports.note: No tests; decision D-02 (keep vs OCA mis_builder) is open.

mumtaz_jewellery.note: Jawhar. No dependency on any foundation or platform module.

mumtaz_jewellery_website.note: Jawhar public-site door: demo requests into the CRM.

c2p_project_tracker.note: C2P group internal. Installed on core2plus.com (Mumtaz_C2P) on 25 Nov 2026.

mumtaz_media_buying.note: Media-agency vertical; either promote to an edition or keep as a customer extension.

mumtaz_ceo_dashboard.note: Documented in docs/erp/00-AUDIT.md as the media-agency dashboard.

faizy_ai.note: Faizy is a separate venture. AI team addon on top of faizy_core; brought to main from the production branch 22 Nov 2026.

faizy_pilot.note: Faizy is a separate venture. Evidence gate on faizy.order; brought to main from the production branch 22 Nov 2026.

c2p_appointment.note: Installed in Mumtaz_C2P. Brought from the production branch 21 Nov 2026. Three copies exist on the server.

c2p_proposal.note: Installed in Mumtaz_C2P (19.0.17.0.0). Brought from the production branch 21 Nov 2026.

c2p_master_agent.note: Installed in Mumtaz_C2P. Existed only in the server's system addons folder until 21 Nov 2026. REVIEW-05 open.

c2p_work_hub.note: C2P group internal. My Work Today and quick task updates. Installed on core2plus.com (Mumtaz_C2P) on 25 Nov 2026.

c2p_meeting_actions.note: C2P group internal. Minutes of meeting; action items convert to tasks once. Installed on core2plus.com (Mumtaz_C2P) on 25 Nov 2026.

c2p_client_onboarding.note: C2P group internal. Client master record on res.partner and onboarding checklist on the portfolio project; access register holds vault references only. Installed on core2plus.com (Mumtaz_C2P) on 25 Nov 2026.

c2p_milestone_forecast.note: C2P group internal. Commitment and forecast dates per milestone with calculated health; reason required on date changes. Installed on core2plus.com (Mumtaz_C2P) on 25 Nov 2026.
